user.title: Connect an Aevocam feed
user.description: Choose how you want to enter credentials for this feed.

device_code.title: Enter device code
device_code.description: Paste the device code from Aevocam. It looks like 2.6/283526884921.

data_description.device_code: The combined feed ID and passcode shown in Aevocam, separated by a slash.

credentials.title: Enter feed credentials
credentials.description: Enter the feed ID and passcode from Aevocam.

data_description.feed_id: The Aevocam feed identifier for this upload target.
data_description.passcode: The passcode for this feed, used to authorize uploads.

details.title: Select a camera
details.description: Choose the Home Assistant camera that should upload snapshots to this Aevocam feed.

data_description.camera_entity_id: Snapshots are taken from this camera when you press the upload button.

name.title: Name this upload
name.description: Choose a name for this Aevocam upload mapping.

data_description.feed_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant for this feed mapping.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aevocam snapshot upload
reconfigure.description: Choose how you want to update this feed.

reconfigure_device_code.title: Update with device code
reconfigure_device_code.description: Paste a device code and review the camera settings.

data_description.device_code: The combined feed ID and passcode shown in Aevocam, separated by a slash.
data_description.camera_entity_id: Snapshots are taken from this camera when you press the upload button.
data_description.feed_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant for this feed mapping.

reconfigure_credentials.title: Update feed credentials
reconfigure_credentials.description: Update the feed ID, passcode, camera, or feed name.

data_description.feed_id: The Aevocam feed identifier for this upload target.
data_description.passcode: The passcode for this feed, used to authorize uploads.
data_description.camera_entity_id: Snapshots are taken from this camera when you press the upload button.
data_description.feed_name: A friendly name shown in Home Assistant for this feed mapping.

error.invalid_device_code: The Aevocam device code is invalid. Use the form feed_id/passcode.
error.invalid_credentials: The Aevocam feed ID or passcode is invalid.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Aevocam. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_configuration: One or more configuration values are invalid.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to Aevocam.

abort.already_configured: This Aevocam feed is already configured.
